title: Proper presented projective bundle of O plus F
statement: For every scheme S and finite locally free module F of constant rank d [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], there exists a presentation P of Sym(O_S plus F) [def-amb-vector-projective-presentation-data] whose relative Proj structural map is proper. If d=0 this structural map is an isomorphism. The affine presentations retain their actual generator restriction maps.

source.place: Tags 01OA, 01OB, 01OE and 01NG; projective bundles and their standard affine charts

proof.text: Form the product of the unit module and F. Evaluation preserves binary products, giving its sections as O(V) × F(V), with restriction compatibility from naturality of the product projections. Restricting to a free cover for F and adjoining the unit frame proves rank d+1.

source.place: Tags 01OA, 01OB, 01OE and 01NG; projective bundles and their standard affine charts

proof.text: Apply the existing projective-bundle tautological geometry to that module. Transport its section symmetric algebra equivalences along the product equivalences. Symmetric degree equals the nth power of the degree-one image, so the transported equivalences give precisely the Presentation grading. Naturality gives its generator restriction equation. The selected realization supplies properness and the rank-zero structural isomorphism.
